answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Every claim climbs the ridge of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ocean re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. The comet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
